title: Engram revoked-grant rotation readiness exceeds 20 seconds in the full Rust gate
outcome: The revoked-grant rotation regression passes reliably within its unchanged enablement budget in the maintained full gate; diagnostic evidence identifies whether the failure is test/runner assumptions or product startup under supported load, rather than dismissing it as contention.
acceptance: Capture the failed readiness phase (process startup/execution versus pipe collection) and identify a falsifiable root cause using retained run diagnostics; a passing retry alone is not diagnosis.

Fix the demonstrated test/runner or product cause without ignoring/quarantining the test, raising the 20-second production deadline, or retrying until green; the exact reviewed input passes the focused test and full maintained gate.
